t: Magnusson self-levelling cross-line laser level is an ideal alignment tool for professional tradespeople and serious DIY enthusiasts. It quickly projects bright green horizontal and vertical lines as a cross, ensuring precise measurement and layout for tasks such as kitchen fitting, stud work, or picture hanging. With an impressive working range of up to 15 metres, the laser level offers excellent visibility and accuracy of ±0.3mm/m to deliver reliable results. The IP54 rating provides protection for indoor and outdoor environments, and a 1/4" thread allows for secure tripod mounting on site.
